gloss: to fall asleep; to drop off

definitions.gloss: to fall asleep; to drop off; to be sound asleep
definitions.explanation: To pass into sleep; in the ている form, to be fast asleep.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{寝入|ねい}った。
{寝入|ねい}った⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起|お}こされた→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: I had just dropped off when a phone call woke me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れていた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぐっすり→ぐっすり：02676_gussuri⟧{寝入|ねい}ってしまった。
examples.english: I was so tired that I fell fast asleep as soon as I got into the futon.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive; there is no transitive counterpart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ぐっすり→ぐっすり：02676_gussuri⟧{寝入|ねい}る (to fall fast asleep)
- {寝入|ねい}った⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧ (just after falling asleep)
- {寝入|ねい}りばな (the moment just after one falls asleep)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寝付|ねつ}く→寝付く：04646_netsuku⟧: to get to sleep, often with difficulty in view (⟦{寝付|ねつ}けない→寝付く：04646_netsuku⟧, can't get to sleep)
- {眠|ねむ}り{込|こ}む: to fall into a deep sleep
- {寝入|ねい}る stresses the moment of passing into sleep; {寝入|ねい}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "is fast asleep"
